headline: Figured Out?
caption:
Merab Dvalishvili says he's much better than Petr Yan, while Yan says he has Merab figured out.
Merab or Yan? 👇

Yan took the UFC bantamweight title from Dvalishvili by decision last December after Merab won their first fight. The trilogy co-headlines UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi on Saturday.

🔥 Hot take: The trilogy winner is the best bantamweight of this era.
Disagree? Tell me why you're wrong.
